CONSTRUCTION_FEASIBILITY: Static native-model descriptor preparation is possible after exact targets/variant ownership are sealed; no execution is needed to define the two-field input, but none is constructed here
EXPECTED_NATIVE_OCCURRENCE: Required for complete original bundle event-trace/persistence/reload assurance; optional pure APPLY_EVENT transition alone is insufficient to claim full A15 completion

changed.rule: Each disjoint required accepted-support source at exact current/prefix boundary; no arbitrary target; existing provenance/admission/proof dependency membership must determine target partition

NOT_NATIVE_DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS.parent_event: No input field; later recording uses input bundle head
NOT_NATIVE_DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS.post_snapshot: No input field; native-produced output; cannot serve as expected_snapshot
NOT_NATIVE_DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS.reason: No reason field; native proof/resume reason output is compared independently
NOT_NATIVE_DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS.receipt: No receipt ID field; native receipt dependencies/claims determine stale propagation if affected
NOT_NATIVE_DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS.route: No separate route field; relevant only if qualified support dependency selects its source; A16 route is not substituted
NOT_NATIVE_DESCRIPTOR_FIELDS.target: changed content-identity set, not an invented action/occurrence target

PROVENANCE_RULE: Exact A15 pre-state/capsule and source-role applicability; unchanged physical source pins. SourceInvalidation has no native provenance field.
SOURCE_PIN_RULE: Use exact eligible native pre-state source/dependency identity and pin/profile. Content identity is not authority identity or occurrence identity. Which exact member belongs to each required variant remains unresolved.
